text:
Good Thursday morning in New York City, where "Rocky Horror" fans are honoring the life of actor Tim Curry.
Here's what else is happening:
- Serena and Venus Williams will team up again to play doubles together at the US Open after receiving a wild card.
- Even though NJ Transit moved a record number of fans to MetLife Stadium during the World Cup, it still lost money.
- Love to read? Here's how to spend a bookish afternoon in Prospect Heights and Park Slope.
- The legendary Studio 54 could soon get a makeover designed for Broadway rather than the dance floor.
- Custody battles for pets in New York divorces are beginning to resemble similar fights over children.
- Rupert Grint will reprise his role as Ron Weasley next year on Broadway.
- The popular Gottesman Pool at the Davis Center in Central Park is temporarily closed due to mechanical issues.
